supersedes.replacement: one consolidated implementation branch and one exact-head develop PR

developMergeGate.reviewEvidenceLocation: GitHub PR #114 and its exact Actions/review head

correctiveDecisions.historicalMigrations: Every migration inherited from the merge base remains byte-identical; lock_timeout is applied and reset by the migration runner; the inherited catalog is SHA-256 checked.
correctiveDecisions.runtimeReadiness: Public capability readiness consumes fresh PostgreSQL worker heartbeats and exact expected API replica vectors; missing or stale runtime state fails closed.
correctiveDecisions.laterEvidenceProducer: .github/workflows/release-evidence-producer.yml publishes manifest-declared exact-head bundles to Actions and attested GHCR using the pinned ORAS wrapper; G42/G50/G71/G90/G91/G92/G93/RC consumers authenticate that producer instead of the G01/G02-only archive workflow.
correctiveDecisions.g03Recovery: The frozen terminal develop SHA remains the G01/G02 authority and must be an ancestor of the exact current develop dispatch head; equality to an obsolete branch head is no longer required.
